arxiv-1810-02254.title: Deriving sorting algorithms via abductive logic program transformation
arxiv-1810-02254.creator: Manuel Hernández
arxiv-1810-02254.description: Abstract Logic program transformation by the unfold/fold method advocates the writing of correct logic programs via the application of some rules to a naive program. This work focuses on how to overcome subgoal-introduction difficulties in synthesizing efficient sorting algorithms from an naive sorting algorithm, through logic program transformation and abductive reasoning.

arxiv-2112-00096.creator: Faezeh Zarrinkhat, \authormark 1,2,* Joel Lamberg, \authormark 2 Aleksi Tamminen, \authormark 2 Mariangela Baggio, \authormark 2 Juha Ala-Laurinaho, \authormark 2 Elsayed E. M. Khaled, \authormark 3,4 Juan Rius, \authormark 1 Jordi Romeu, \authormark 1 and Zachary Taylor, \authormark 2
arxiv-2112-00096.description: Abstract Coupling to longitudinal modes of thin spherical shells, under Gaussian-beam illumination, was explored with a theoretical method based on Fourier-optics analysis and vector spherical harmonics. The illumination frequency band was fixed between 100 100 - 600 600 GHz and the outer spherical shell radius of curvature and thickness are 7.5 7.5 mm and 0.5 0.5 mm, respectively.

arxiv-2209-14410.description: Abstract This work focuses on active galactic nuclei (AGNs), and the relation between the sizes of the hot dust continuum and the broad-line region (BLR). We find that the continuum size measured using optical/near-infrared interferometry (OI) is roughly twice that measured by reverberation mapping (RM).

arxiv-2301-09439.title: Autoencoder-based Joint Communication and Sensing of Multiple Targets Thanks: This work has received funding from the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) within the project Open6GHub (grant agreement 16KISK010).
arxiv-2301-09439.creator: Charlotte Muth and Laurent Schmalen
arxiv-2301-09439.description: Abstract We investigate the potential of AE for building a JCAS ( JCAS ) system that enables communication with one user while detecting multiple radar targets and estimating their positions. Foremost, we develop a suitable encoding scheme for the training of the AE and for targeting a fixed false alarm rate of the target detection during training.

arxiv-2306-01564.title: Cosmologies with positive λ \lambda : Hierarchies of future behaviour.
arxiv-2306-01564.creator: Helmut Friedrich
arxiv-2306-01564.description: Abstract Smooth Cauchy data on 𝕊 3 \mathbb{S}^{3} for the Einstein- λ \lambda -vacuum field equations with cosmological constant λ > 0 \lambda>0 that are sufficiently close to de Sitter data develop into a solution that admits a smooth conformal boundary 𝒥 + {\cal J}^{+} in its future.

arxiv-2503-01563.title: On Coupling Constraints in Pessimistic Linear Bilevel Optimization
arxiv-2503-01563.creator: Dorothee Henke, Henri Lefebvre, Martin Schmidt, Johannes Thürauf
arxiv-2503-01563.description: Abstract . The literature on pessimistic bilevel optimization with coupling constraints is rather scarce and it has been common sense that these problems are harder to tackle than pessimistic bilevel problems without coupling constraints. In this note, we show that this is not the case.

arxiv-2505-10347.title: Uniform Loss vs. Specialized Optimization: A Comparative Analysis in Multi-Task Learning
arxiv-2505-10347.creator: Gabriel S. Gama, Valdir Grassi Jr
arxiv-2505-10347.description: Abstract Specialized Multi-Task Optimizers (SMTOs) balance task learning in Multi-Task Learning by addressing issues like conflicting gradients and differing gradient norms, which hinder equal-weighted task training. However, recent critiques suggest that equally weighted tasks can achieve competitive results compared to SMTOs, arguing that previous SMTO results were influenced by poor hyperparameter optimization and lack of regularization.

arxiv-2506-09760.title: The Additive Bachelier model with an application to the oil option market in the Covid period
arxiv-2506-09760.creator: Roberto Baviera & Michele Domenico Massaria
arxiv-2506-09760.description: Abstract In April 2020, the Chicago Mercantile Exchange temporarily switched the pricing formula for West Texas Intermediate oil market options from the Black model to the Bachelier model. In this context, we introduce an Additive Bachelier model that provides a simple closed-form solution and a good description of the Implied volatility surface.

pmc-12733736.title: Genetic Differentiation of Bisexual and Parthenogenetic Populations of Plant Louse Cacopsylla ledi (Hemiptera, Psylloidea)
pmc-12733736.creator: Nazar A Shapoval, Seppo Nokkala, Christina Nokkala, Galina N Shapoval, Eugenia S Labina, Anna E Romanovich, Valentina G Kuznetsova, Steven Trewick
pmc-12733736.description: Simple SummaryThe vast majority of insects reproduce bisexually, and unisexual species that reproduce via parthenogenesis comprise a negligible fraction of all species. To date, very little is known about the evolutionary potential of parthenogenesis, and there remains little research related to this topic. Parthenogenetic lineages are generally considered short-lived on an evolutionary scale.

pmc-12738610.title: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons in surface sediments of Lingshui County lagoons: distribution, source analysis, and ecological risk assessment
pmc-12738610.creator: Bingxin Zhong, Zhifu Wang, Baijuan Yang, Weihua Feng, Nina Ma, Baoxing Huang, Hengtao Xu, Duian Lv
pmc-12738610.description: The Lingshui County lagoons represent Hainan’s first marine special conservation area, yet little is known about the distribution and source characteristics of PAHs in their surface sediments. This study employed principal component analysis, PMF, and MERM-Q modeling to determine the distribution, sources, and potential ecological risks of PAHs in Lingshui Lagoon’s surface sediments.
